title: isabel-ramirez-notes-to-self-2026-03-04
content:
Morning scratchpad - quick brain dump and TODOs (will clean up later)

Top priorities for today:
- Finish review of PR #4821 (perf regression fix, batching path). Leave inline comments about the allocator change.
- Run local perf harness for seq-len=1024 on v2 build (use the new kernel selection flag). Collect p50/p95 numbers and push to GH issue.
- Follow up with SRE on the canary rollback thresholds (email + ping on Slack) - need confirmation before tomorrow's deploy.

Meetings:
- 10:00am Standup (15m) - blockers: infra quota bump for dedicated clusters.
- 11:30am Sync with Maya (30m) - migration plan for KV-cache TTL changes; bring the migration checklist.
- 3:00pm Postmortem review (optional) - read the draft beforehand (CONFLUENCE-1234).

Short TODOs / reminders:
- Add a note in PR about potential user-facing perf drop for short context (<=64).
- Add metric for batch fill-rate on the dashboard (observability ticket).
- Check Dedicated customer test harness logs for flapping on 2026-03-02.
- Buy birthday card for Sam (in-person gift) - remember to drop by office main desk by 4pm.
- Refill coffee at home, need beans (Colombian roast) - add to grocery list.

Debug steps (for local run):
1) git checkout perf/kern-opt && make build-release
2) ./tools/run_harness --model r-instruct-2b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --kern-select=auto --out perf-2026-03-04.json
3) python tools/compare_perf.py perf-2026-03-04.json perf-baseline.json --metrics p50 p95

Notes to self / brainstorming:
- If allocator fix reduces p95 but increases latency for small batches, consider a runtime flag to prefer tail latency for premium tenants.
- Could we expose a recommended config for startup customers that sets batching window to 8ms and TTL to 30s? Write quick doc and add to onboarding checklist.

Follow-ups to assign:
- Jordan: validate KV cache TTL migration steps against live traffic (due Fri).
- Maya: draft rollback runbook and include the threshold numbers we agreed on in today's sync.

Random personal TODOs:
- Dishwasher.
- Dentist appointment Wednesday 2pm - confirm with calendar.
- Send thank-you note to conference host (email draft in Drafts).

End of notes. Will convert to proper tickets and tidy up later tonight.
